problem:
I changed my university password this morning.
Now my Windows laptop won't connect to campus Wi-Fi,
but my phone still works.
diagnosis: Your Windows laptop may still be using the old cached password for eduroam after changing your university password.
solution: Forget the eduroam network in your Windows laptop's Wi-Fi settings
Reconnect to campus Wi-Fi and enter your new password
Verify your university account is active and there are no reported Wi-Fi outages
